title: Storefront speed fixes: production build and regression checks passed
summary: Verified single responsive hero, smaller default banner sources, immediately visible catalogue, and parallel bounded homepage requests.

changes.detail: One responsive picture selects desktop OR mobile hero; mutually exclusive preload hints replace two eager image elements and duplicate backdrop layers. Supported remote images use the existing optimizer, with original-source fallback.
Hero headline, action buttons and image appear without entrance delays. Catalogue is visible in initial HTML; scroll effects progressively enhance only offscreen content.
Ecomedia read starts alongside catalogue/settings requests, and optional banner/post reads have 1.8-second timeouts.

WebP defaults reduce desktop source 2145760 to 145308 bytes and mobile source 2158587 to 145360 bytes; originals retained. Exact legacy default paths map to new assets, including encoded paths in existing settings.
Removed a leftover visibility-hook call caught by initial TypeScript/regression checks; subsequent checks pass.

validation.name: Focused regressions
validation.detail: 5 loading-performance tests, 3 catalogue tests, 3 product-cache failure tests and 6 change-history tests passed (17 total). Tests cover rendering, fallback, legacy mapping, concurrent requests, deadlines and image decoding/size.

validation.name: TypeScript
validation.detail: Root tsc --noEmit --incremental false passed; final production build also passed type validation.

validation.name: Lint
validation.detail: Focused Next lint passed with 2 existing unoptimized-img warnings in community markup. Full build lint completed with existing repository warnings.

validation.name: Production build
validation.detail: Final network-enabled next-build.mjs completed successfully, generating 249 pages. Initial restricted build could not fetch Google Fonts; network-enabled build resolved this.

validation.name: Built homepage verification
validation.detail: Actual generated HTML contains one hero img in a picture, viewport-specific preload hints, and both optimized WebP source paths. Built HTML is 600306 bytes; baseline differences are not treated as measured user speedup.

validation.name: Live validation
validation.detail: No deployment. No post-change production/browser/Lighthouse/mobile performance measurement. Public baseline remains environment-specific; see linked performance document.
